---
name: AI task
about: Request a structured AI-ready task brief for implementation, review, or planning.
title: "[AI Task]: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Goal

What exact outcome do you want?

## Why

Why does this matter from a product, user, or engineering perspective?

## Scope

Which directories, modules, or surfaces are in scope?

## Non-goals

What should not be changed?

## Start files

Which files should the agent inspect first?

## Constraints

List compatibility, security, performance, workflow, or style constraints.

## Expected output

Code changes, document, plan, review findings, test updates, or another concrete artifact.

## Verification

List exact commands or manual checks.

## Definition of done

How will we know this task is complete?
